0022600016.text: Boston hosts this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game at 3-1 with a three-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, while Chicago is 1-4 and has lost three straight, sitting 4th in the Central and 12th in the East. The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Devin Carter is out for Boston with illness, while Chicago will be without Dailyn Swain (back soreness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring).
